snippet.title: Brass Reveal Trailer v1.4
snippet.description:
Cozy, relaxing adventure game "Brass." (In-development footage)
Wishlist now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3002060/Brass/

In a small mountain village, Brass works at the only post office. As the player, you take on the role of Brass, delivering letters and packages while interacting with the charming villagers. One day, a letter from his grandma in a coastal town sets Brass off on a new adventure, uncovering secrets and solving mysteries.

Music Written by Svyatoslav Petrov
Played by
Anastasiia Tikhanovska - violins
Tetiana Kravchenko - violoncello 
Maria Vakhnenko - viola
